Please join me in presenting Resolution No. 164-38 (COR) – Relative to recognizing the Autism Community Together (ACT) for its efforts to promote autism awareness and provide support to families, and on the observance of “Autism Awareness Month” during the month of April 2026, with this year’s theme: “Different is our Superpower!” ; and commending the members of ACT, and the families and caregivers of all persons with autism spectrum disorders for their unconditional love and dedication to bettering the lives of their children,…
